title: The Shapeshifter Secret and the True Flight — Part 5

series.summary: Gon distinguishes the two identical beasts while Kurapika discovers the truth about the woman. The Kiriko reveal they are exam navigators and fly the trio toward Zaban City.

segments.voiceover_text: Gon corners the monster in a clearing, but notices something strange. Looking closely, he realizes this beasts face and voice are different from the one he struck earlier.
Kurapika arrives with the woman, while Leorio carries the bandaged husband. The monsters drop their act and reveal they are the Kiriko, shapeshifters conducting the official Navigator exam.
The Kiriko praise Kurapikas sharp intellect, Leorios selfless medical compassion, and Gons uncanny instincts. All three applicants have officially passed.
Spreading their massive wings, the Kiriko carry Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio into the skies, soaring directly toward Zaban City for the real Hunter Exam.
